```{r setup, include=FALSE, cache = FALSE}
library(knitr)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(vitae)
library(tidyverse)
library(vroom)

# Date convention used across the CV: AP/Chicago month abbreviations
# ("Jan.", "May", "June", "July", "Sept.") and en-dash ranges ("Aug. 2024 – Present").
.cv_months <- c("Jan.", "Feb.", "Mar.", "Apr.", "May", "June",
                "July", "Aug.", "Sept.", "Oct.", "Nov.", "Dec.")
.en_dash <- "–"

# Date -> "Sept. 2024"
fmt_month <- function(d) {
  if_else(is.na(d), NA_character_,
          paste(.cv_months[lubridate::month(d)], lubridate::year(d)))
}

# "Sept. 2024", "September 2024", "Fall 2026" -> first-of-month Date (for sorting)
parse_month <- function(x) {
  words <- paste(c(month.name, "Sept", month.abb, "Fall", "Spring", "Summer", "Winter"),
                 collapse = "|")
  m <- stringr::str_match(x, paste0("^(", words, ")\\.?\\s+(\\d{4})"))
  mon <- dplyr::recode(substr(m[, 2], 1, 3), Fal = "Sep", Spr = "Jan", Sum = "May", Win = "Dec")
  lubridate::make_date(as.integer(m[, 3]), match(mon, month.abb), 1)
}

# Rewrite free-text dates to the convention: any month spelling -> abbreviation,
# " - " between dates -> spaced en dash
fmt_dates_text <- function(x) {
  months <- paste0("(", paste(c(month.name, "Sept", month.abb), collapse = "|"), ")")
  x <- stringr::str_replace_all(
    x, paste0("\\b", months, "\\b\\.?(?=\\s+\\d{4})"),
    function(m) .cv_months[match(substr(m, 1, 3), month.abb)]
  )
  stringr::str_replace_all(x, "\\s+-\\s+", paste0(" ", .en_dash, " "))
}
```
